name: How much does professional paint preparation add to the overall cost of painting a house?

mainEntity.name: How much does professional paint preparation add to the overall cost of painting a house?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of professional paint preparation varies significantly based on the condition of the surfaces, the size of the project, and the specific tasks required (e.g., extensive scraping, repairs, power washing). It can range from 20% to 50% or more of the total painting project cost. For instance, a house needing minimal cleaning and light sanding will be on the lower end, while a property requiring lead paint encapsulation, extensive wood repair, or stucco patching will incur higher preparation expenses.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional paint preparation can add 20-50% or more to the total painting cost, depending on surface condition and required tasks.
